verified.session_timer: Selected 15 minutes; the active session showed 'Session active · 15:00 left'; Stop session returned to 'Computer paired · session stopped'; the timer was restored to Off.
verified.start_stop: Start session and Stop session both changed the visible state and the three-step list correctly.
verified.settings: Settings -> Session opened the timer choices; the selected value persisted on return to Settings and Home.
verified.rotation: accelerometer_rotation=0 plus user_rotation=1 produced UI rotation 1 and 2376x1080 bounds; restored to 0/0 and portrait.
verified.talkback: TalkBack and Andromeda were both bound; visible focus rings appeared on Settings and Stop; a tap on Start session started a session while TalkBack was enabled.
verified.service_rebind: UiAutomation/uiautomator dump suppressed accessibility services; the hardened service retried the bind and the UI returned to 'All set. You lead.' without an app restart.

builds: Debug, release and debugAndroidTest APK builds passed after the service lifecycle change; the debug APK was installed over the existing app data.
limitations: TalkBack full focus order, labels, double-tap activation and permission/pairing screen traversal still need a human pass.
The TalkBack first-run hint overlay and synthetic key events do not reproduce a human traversal.
The 15-minute timer was stopped manually. Emulator smoke verifies selection and persistence; actual expiry/auto-stop has not been verified.
UiAutomation suppresses accessibility services, so screenshots rather than uiautomator dumps were used for readiness checks.
Screenshots and device serial identifiers are excluded from Git.
